question: During a controlled motion experiment, a small trolley moves along a straight track. Its displacement from a fixed reference point after $t$ seconds is modelled by $s(t)=4\sin t$ metres, where $0\leq t\leq2\pi$. The monitoring system uses the first and second derivatives of displacement to calculate the trolley's instantaneous velocity and acceleration. A positive velocity indicates motion in the positive direction of the track, while a negative velocity indicates motion in the opposite direction.(a) Obtain the velocity and acceleration functions.(b) Calculate the velocity and acceleration at $t=\frac{\pi}{3}$.(c) Determine the instants when the trolley is at rest.(d) Determine the time intervals during which the trolley moves in the positive and negative directions.
explanation: (a)The velocity is the instantaneous rate of change of displacement.`v(t)=\frac{ds}{dt}=4\cos t`The acceleration is the instantaneous rate of change of velocity.`a(t)=\frac{dv}{dt}=-4\sin t`(b)At $t=\frac{\pi}{3}$,`v\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=4\cos\frac{\pi}{3}=4\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)=2\ \text{m/s}a\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=-4\sin\frac{\pi}{3}=-4\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)=-2\sqrt{3}\ \text{m/s}^2`(c)The trolley is at rest when $v(t)=0$. Therefore,`4\cos t=0`Within $0\leq t\leq2\pi$,`t=\frac{\pi}{2}\quad\text{or}\quad t=\frac{3\pi}{2}`(d)The trolley moves in the positive direction when $v(t)>0$, that is, when $\cos t>0$. Hence, it moves in the positive direction for`0\leq t<\frac{\pi}{2}\quad\text{and}\quad\frac{3\pi}{2}<t\leq2\pi`It moves in the negative direction when $\cos t<0$. Hence, it moves in the negative direction for`\frac{\pi}{2}<t<\frac{3\pi}{2}`

options.A:
(a) $v=4\sin t,\ a=4\cos t$
(b) $v=2\sqrt{3}\ \text{m/s},\ a=2\ \text{m/s}^2$
(c) $t=0,\pi,2\pi$
(d) Positive on $(0,\pi)$; negative on $(\pi,2\pi)$
options.B:
(a) $v=-4\cos t,\ a=4\sin t$
(b) $v=-2\ \text{m/s},\ a=2\sqrt{3}\ \text{m/s}^2$
(c) $t=\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}$
(d) Positive on $\left(\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}\right)$; negative otherwise
options.C:
(a) $v=4\cos t,\ a=-4\sin t$
(b) $v=2\ \text{m/s},\ a=-2\sqrt{3}\ \text{m/s}^2$
(c) $t=\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}$
(d) Positive on $\left[0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\cup\left(\frac{3\pi}{2},2\pi\right]$; negative on $\left(\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}\right)$
options.D:
(a) $v=4\cos t,\ a=4\sin t$
(b) $v=2\ \text{m/s},\ a=2\sqrt{3}\ \text{m/s}^2$
(c) $t=\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}$
(d) Positive on $\left(\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}\right)$; negative on the remaining intervals
